paragraphs: Peerless VR is a U.S.-based virtual reality training company whose team includes former public safety professionals. The team develops simulators for law enforcement training. Peerless VR was founded by the original team behind Apex Officer and launched in January 2025.

The home page presents a VR and MR training simulator. It is described as built for Law Enforcement, Corrections, Military, and Commercial. The same page lists a law enforcement training platform. It also lists a shoot house and firearm simulator.

Testimonials on the home page are attributed to Winchester Police Department, the IUP Police Academy, and Mineral County Sheriff's Office. One of those comments describes the system as a purchase for the department.

quote.text: Rooted in U.S. public safety culture, practices, and real-world fieldwork
